classification: assistant-written summaries of historical intent; not quotations

items.summary: Create a repeatable end-to-end ecommerce workflow that connects research, tools, prompts, skills, images and ad scripts. Retain enough context to continue across sessions, and choose useful existing components without being constrained by the previous architecture.

Customer-facing copy should sound natural and relevant, not expose internal research counts or process terminology. Preserve effective design work and improve visible output instead of repeatedly producing frameworks or regressing good sections.
A product or supplier reference, or an upstream research brief, should lead to convincing brand-aware UGC. The desired result is a usable ad rather than an isolated generated clip.
Reduce hands-on work across advertising, editing, brand building, social media and websites while maintaining professional output quality.
Maintain shared context across workers and remember how workflows and decisions developed so later work builds on prior learning.

Build connected operational infrastructure with understandable relationships between acquisition, revenue, outreach, social media, advertising accounts and databases. Choose what the business needs instead of treating a few examples as an exhaustive specification.

interpretation: These paraphrases summarize selected historical records, not current scope limitations. Historical item bodies and aliases are preserved. Current requirements take precedence, including the full original vision as commissioned delivery, connected supplier/back-office functions and 60 live product tests per month as operating and final acceptance requirements. Technical originals remain separate; original owner messages are not published.

current_scope_reconciliation.status: Historical originals preserved; the full connected-business intent is part of current commissioned delivery, not an optional future target.
supersedes: 60 tests described as nonbinding operating aspiration
current_scope_reconciliation.current_runtime_and_creative: Both Codex and Claude power development and deployment through verified official access. Prefer direct image and video APIs; aggregator workflows require output-quality justification inside the owned engine.
current_scope_reconciliation.current_acceptance: Complete connected system and actual monthly live-test run; no demo, scaffold, disconnected automation or partial build as final delivery. Measured visual/functional creative quality and whole-workflow replacement/simplification/restore are included.
current_scope_reconciliation.commercial_boundary: $6,000-$8,000 negotiable engineering ceiling, roughly one-month target, final milestones/price/schedule and measurement windows before hire; operating spend separately approved.
